queues.title: Family relationship conflicts
queues.shared_reason: the family name matched but the corroborating evidence did not
queues.evidence: vendor, PostScript prefix, version, glyph coverage, package
queues.exceptions: a family name is a hypothesis, never identity proof

queues.title: No known provenance
queues.shared_reason: no known acquisition source and no evidence of any kind. PROVENANCE IS MISSING — and rights attach to provenance.
queues.exceptions: the paperwork may exist outside materials/ entirely

queues.title: Font-relevant licence evidence, unreviewed
queues.shared_reason: licence evidence that actually discusses fonts — and is UNREVIEWED
queues.evidence: OFL / Apache / EULA text, read and classified
queues.exceptions: evidence is not approval; an OFL grants nothing until a human reads it
queues.recommended_human_action: review the licence and record a decision

queues.title: Nearby evidence that does not discuss fonts
queues.shared_reason: a licence document sits beside the font but never mentions fonts — it may govern something else entirely (a stock vector, for instance)
queues.exceptions: a font licence that avoids the word 'font' would be misfiled here
queues.recommended_human_action: confirm the document does not cover this font; find one that does

queues.title: Suspected system-font copies
queues.shared_reason: the NAME TABLE names an OS or major foundry — a suspicion, never a finding of wrongdoing
queues.exceptions: a licensed Microsoft font is perfectly legal; an internal system dependency may be legitimate
queues.recommended_human_action: confirm licensed / internal dependency / restricted / quarantine

queues.title: System-font status uncertain
queues.shared_reason: partial foundry evidence, below the suspicion threshold
queues.evidence: vendor ID without a corroborating copyright string
queues.exceptions: weak evidence is not evidence of innocence either

queues.title: Exact duplicates — TECHNICAL identity only
queues.shared_reason: byte-identical files. ONE technical decision genuinely covers them — and it covers NOTHING about rights.
queues.exceptions: EXACT BYTES DO NOT PROVE IDENTICAL RIGHTS. See queue H.
queues.recommended_human_action: record the technical audit once per hash

queues.title: Cross-package duplicates — separate RIGHTS review
queues.shared_reason: identical bytes arriving from different or unverified sources. Rights attach to PROVENANCE, not content — one package's licence never clears an identical file from somewhere else.
queues.evidence: source package + licence-evidence association per copy
queues.exceptions: NONE. This queue exists precisely because the batch is unsafe.

queues.title: Source-package rights review
queues.shared_reason: a credible package boundary — the natural unit of a rights decision
queues.exceptions: one package's licence NEVER clears another
queues.recommended_human_action: review the package as one rights unit

queues.title: Same family, conflicting vendor or evidence
queues.shared_reason: the same family arrives from several packages with different evidence
queues.exceptions: the families may be unrelated despite the shared name
queues.recommended_human_action: review each family × package pair separately

queues.title: Unsupported format (.fon)
queues.shared_reason: legacy Windows .fon bitmap fonts — there is no sfnt to parse
queues.evidence: fontTools cannot read the format at all
queues.exceptions: unreadable is not absent: they are still in materials/
queues.recommended_human_action: confirm they are system fonts, or find a tool that reads them

queues.title: Parse failures
queues.shared_reason: the font claims a format it does not honour
queues.exceptions: a corrupt file may still be a licensed one

queues.title: Quarantine candidates
queues.shared_reason: quarantine is PROPOSED pending human review. Nothing is deleted, moved or permanently rejected.
queues.exceptions: the batch is defined by FOLDER while suspicion is defined by NAME TABLE — accepting it quarantines fonts never individually implicated
queues.recommended_human_action: accept, refuse, or narrow the proposal

queues.title: Curated starter-library candidates
queues.shared_reason: a shortlist for review: known package, font-relevant evidence, healthy, unconflicted. NOT approved, NOT active, NOT retrievable.
queues.exceptions: the licence evidence is UNREVIEWED — a candidate may still be rejected outright
queues.recommended_human_action: review the licence, then decide whether it joins the library
